items.title: Professor Longhair (Henry Roeland Byrd) Interview, 1975-11-13
items.q: Norbert Hess is mentioned by the Interviewer as a source of information about Professor Longhair; the Interviewee does not mention Norbert Hess.

ctx.x: Turner's out on the coast, I know.

Could I bring him for the festival? I heard he was, he was, he was drinking a lot. Yeah. And I heard from Norbert Hess that he was just getting over it and it's possible. But it might not be possible.
Norbert has to know how to get in touch with him?
